override._why: New Game opens NAME ENTRY for the family name (from about 49 s, やまだ filled in); A and Start only type kana, and confirming needs 決定 at the end of the bottom row, then はい on a prompt that defaults to いいえ. First screen: A, Down x6 to the bottom row, Left wraps to 決定, A, Left to はい, A. The given-name screen starts with the cursor in the mode column (ひらがな); Up x3 then A puts it on あ (in the grid Up only moves), then the same confirm. The story intro follows.
